def hidden_rule_fn(state):
    n = len(state)
    m = len(state[0])
    result = [[0]*m for _ in range(n)]
    for r in range(n):
        for c in range(m):
            ne = state[(r-1)%n][(c+1)%m]
            nw = state[(r-1)%n][(c-1)%m]
            se = state[(r+1)%n][(c+1)%m]
            sw = state[(r+1)%n][(c-1)%m]
            result[r][c] = (ne + nw + se + sw) % 3
    return result
